headline: Chainalysis customers' data stolen in AI-assisted cyberattack
summary: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis confirms a multifront cyberattack exposed names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users.
details: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis has confirmed that hackers obtained sensitive personal information for all of its users. The data includes names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens, following a breach of the company's network security.

The attackers utilized AI agent-assisted offensive techniques to gain unauthorized access to Chainalysis systems. This sophisticated attack also involved an 'on-path attack,' also known as an adversary-in-the-middle attack, which exposed a subset of customer passwords.

Chainalysis serves high-profile clients including government agencies like the FBI and US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, as well as major companies such as Microsoft, Coinbase, and Barclays. It remains unclear if the exposed data poses additional risks to these customers.

The company detected 'abnormal activity' and temporarily took down its login page and its real-time cryptocurrency threat monitoring service. Access to its Reactor and Data Solutions services was also removed during the investigation.

While Chainalysis has begun restoring access to some services and is asking customers to reset credentials, questions remain about the source of the on-path attack and how the attackers managed to decrypt any traffic. The company has not detailed the specific AI agents used in the breach.
caption:
Chainalysis confirms a massive data breach affecting ALL of its users, including names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens.

Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis has confirmed that hackers obtained sensitive personal information for all of its users. The data includes names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens, following a breach of the company's network security.

The attackers utilized AI agent-assisted offensive techniques to gain unauthorized access to Chainalysis systems. This sophisticated attack also involved an 'on-path attack,' also known as an adversary-in-the-middle attack, which exposed a subset of customer passwords.

Chainalysis serves high-profile clients including government agencies like the FBI and US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, as well as major companies such as Microsoft, Coinbase, and Barclays. It remains unclear if the exposed data poses additional risks to these customers.

The company detected 'abnormal activity' and temporarily took down its login page and its real-time cryptocurrency threat monitoring service. Access to its Reactor and Data Solutions services was also removed during the investigation.

While Chainalysis has begun restoring access to some services and is asking customers to reset credentials, questions remain about the source of the on-path attack and how the attackers managed to decrypt any traffic. The company has not detailed the specific AI agents used in the breach.
